beats.title: Fighters exit arena and are approached by Lysandra
beats.summary: The fighters leave the arena to applause. Outside, Ephanna, Bonogo, Stafl and Baergrom are approached by Lysandra, who is dressed casually and seems anxious. The group almost mistakes her for someone else. She learns they are heading to the Evergreen Apothecary for the Herbal Tea Workshop to meet Caelynn and Karsemine, and decides to join them.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-5:40a1bbd868a3:span:40a1bbd868a3:14-14

The small group tells her that they are headed over to the Evergreen Apothecary for the Herbal Tea Workshop to catch up with Caelynn and Karsemine.

beats.title: Lysandra reveals guardhouse infiltration request
beats.summary: While walking to the tea workshop, Lysandra reveals she needs the group's help and that she trusts no one else. She explains that each guardhouse is hosting a music festival for guards only, a first, and that only humans are invited. She needs help infiltrating a guardhouse to discover what is really happening.

And to make matters worse, only humans are invited. She explains that she needs help infiltrating a guardhouse to determine what is actually happening.

beats.title: Caelynn and Karsemine arrive at apothecary tea workshop
beats.summary: Caelynn and Karsemine enter the Evergreen Apothecary courtyard and are greeted by enthusiastic elf Elowyn Vireleaf, who leads the workshop on leaves and brewing. The courtyard is set with tables, bowls of leaves, steaming water, mortars and pestles.

beats.title: Karsemine and Caelynn impress Vireleaf with tea brewing
beats.summary: Karsemine brews Blue Cap mushroom tea and impresses Vireleaf. Caelynn then brews perfect tea, including the difficult Stormbark Tea, making another friend and gaining the ability to extract bonuses from brewed teas. Karsemine later brews Rattle Leaf tea and is offered special mushrooms by apprentice Bramblewood. Caelynn buys a traveling tea set.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-5:40a1bbd868a3:span:40a1bbd868a3:16-16
anchor_quotes: Karesmine is first to pick her leaves and brew her own tea. She picks Blue Cap mushrooms and brews a pretty nice tea, impressing Vireleaf. Caelynn chooses her leaves, and after watching Karsemine, brews the perfect tea, really impressing Vireleaf.

Again Caelynn makes a perfect tea, smelling of light char and cedar, and in the process makes another friend. They exchange tips about teas and leaves from various areas and Caelynn gains the ability to extract bonuses from brewed teas.

Karsemine decides to try her luck again with a different tea, this time using Rattle Leaf, and, taking extra time and care, brews a wonderful tea. Vireleaf’s apprentice Bramblewood is very impressed with her skills with the mortar and pestle and offers her some “special” mushrooms to take. Caelynn is so happy with her new brewing skills that she purchases a traveling tea set.

beats.title: Lysandra's exhaustion and group plans at Wolf's Manor
beats.summary: Caelynn reunites with Lysandra and senses she is anxious and exhausted. Lysandra says she has been unable to rest. Baergrom suggests returning to Wolf's Manor so Lysandra can rest while the group plans about the guardhouses. Stafl asks Lysandra for a rough layout of the guard tower and the group begins forming a plan.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-5:40a1bbd868a3:span:40a1bbd868a3:16-16
anchor_quotes: Caelynn is beyond excited to see her friend Lysandra, but immediately senses that something is off. It seems that not only is Lysandra anxious she looks exhausted. She further explains that she has not been able to get any rest. That’s when Baergrom suggests that everyone head back to Wolf’s Manor and then Lysandra can get some rest while the group decides what to do about the guardhouses. While everyone is taking a much needed rest Stafl asks Lysandra for a rough layout of the guard tower and then the group begins to form a plan.

beats.title: Bonogo investigates cursed letter at Gilded Fold
beats.summary: Bonogo leaves the manor to find the Gilded Fold paper shop in the Artisans Quarter, hoping for answers about his cursed letter. He notices side-glances as a Bugbear in a fancy area. The owner Volen initially demands he leave, but after Bonogo shows a blank city guard badge and mentions the letter is cursed and valuable, Volen examines it. He reveals he made the paper for an anonymous elf from a land over the desert, sells Bonogo enchanted burn-resistant paper and dried boar meat for gold, and names the tiefling collaborator as Merella.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-5:40a1bbd868a3:span:40a1bbd868a3:18-18
anchor_quotes: Meanwhile, Bonogo leaves the manor in search of the Gilded Fold - the paper shop in the Artisans Quarter. This is where he hopes to find answers about his cursed letter.

In exchange for gold and some dried boar meat, he sells Bonogo some paper and reveals that the paper is enchanted to resist burning and the name of the tiefling he worked with on the letter is named Merella.

beats.title: Ephanna creates human disguises for guardhouse infiltration
beats.summary: Back at the manor, Ephanna helps Karsemine and Baergrom with human-looking disguises for the guardhouse that evening. Ephanna's experience helps Karsemine blend in perfectly, and she creates a great disguise for Baergrom too. Stafl tests them and can hardly tell neither is human. The group then heads to the library for a short rest.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-5:40a1bbd868a3:span:40a1bbd868a3:18-18
anchor_quotes: Back at the manor, Ephanna is helping Karsemine and Baergrom with human-looking disguises to help get into the guardhouse later that evening. Ephanna has a lot of experience helping Karsemine blend in to many different places so her disguise looks perfect. Though not nearly as good as Karesmine’s, Ephanna creates a great disguise for Baergrom as well. They test it out with Stafl and he can hardly tell that neither one is human. The group then heads to the library for a short rest.

beats.title: Group joins Unity Dance rehearsal at Community Hall
beats.summary: With time before the guardhouse music festival, Caelynn encourages the group to go to Community Hall for the Unity Dance rehearsal. At the outdoor amphitheater they meet director Glinter, who joyfully welcomes new members and explains the dance reenacts the battle for the city of Mirathorn. Caelynn joins first, with backup singing from Ephanna and Stafl. Karsemine and Baergrom use the opportunity to test their human disguises and blend in.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-5:40a1bbd868a3:span:40a1bbd868a3:20-20
anchor_quotes: Seeing that there is time before the music festival at the guardhouse, Caelynn enthusiastically encourages the group to head to Community Hall for the Unity Dance rehearsal.

They explain that the dance is a reenactment of the battle for the city of Mirathorn. Caelynn is the first to join in, followed by some backup singing from Ephanna and Stafl. Karsemine and Baergrom use this opportunity to see if they pass as humans - blending right in.

beats.title: Group infiltrates guardhouse festival with tea-enhanced insight
beats.summary: The group retrieves Lysandra, who changed back into armor after her disguise failed. At the guardhouse entrance, Caelynn brews tea to boost Insight for nervous Lysandra, Stafl and Ephanna. The group passes the initial human check and moves to the rooftop party, passing floors of mingling, eating and drinking. The rooftop is elegant with food and drink booths; the Dustwalker performs in the center. Lysandra thinks things look ok so far. Invisible Bonogo searches the booths for money but finds no easy targets and rejoins the group as they decide their next move.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-5:40a1bbd868a3:span:40a1bbd868a3:20-20
anchor_quotes: The group is ready to get Lysandra, who decided her disguise was terrible and changed back into her armor, and they all head to the guardhouse. At the entrance to the guardhouse the group takes a moment while Caelynn brews some tea to increase Insight for Lysandra (who is looking very nervous), Stafl, and Ephanna. The group easily pass the initial check as humans and head for the party on the rooftop, passing several floors where people are mingling, eating and drinking. The rooftop is an elegant setup and features more food and drink booths. In the center the Dustwalker is performing. After an initial check, Lysandra seems to think things look ok so far. Bonogo, who chose to approach the rooftop while invisible, looks for places where the money is kept at the booths. Seeing no easy targets he circles back to the group who are now deciding what their next plan of action is.
